nodes.description: Public token name string state variable.
Public token symbol string state variable.
Public decimals state variable, default 18, used in supply calculation.
Public total token supply; decremented in burn and burnFrom.
Public mapping of address balances; updated in _transfer, constructor, burn, burnFrom.
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount; updated by approve, transferFrom, burnFrom.
Constructor: mints initial supply to creator and sets name/symbol.
Internal transfer routine that mutates balances both ways.
Public transfer from msg.sender to _to via _transfer.
Public delegated transfer that checks and decrements allowance then calls _transfer.
Public approval setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Public approve plus external callback receiveApproval to the spender contract.
Public burn of msg.sender balance and total supply reduction.
Public burn on behalf of _from, consuming allowance and reducing total supply.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address used as owner for balances and allowances.
Arithmetic update totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) without overflow guard (Solidity 0.4.22).
Arithmetic balance mutation balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in _transfer.
Arithmetic totalSupply -= _value in burn and burnFrom without checked subtraction.
External call spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender,_value,this,_extraData) to an arbitrary contract.
Constructor parameter holding the raw initial token amount.
Constructor parameter for the token name string.
Constructor parameter for the token symbol string.
Source address parameter of _transfer, transferFrom and burnFrom.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer and transfer.
Token amount parameter used across transfer, approve, burn and burnFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve and approveAndCall.
Arbitrary bytes payload forwarded to the approved contract callback.
Local snapshot of combined balances used for the final assert in _transfer.
Local tokenRecipient handle cast from _spender in approveAndCall.

edges.reason: initialSupply is multiplied into the total supply expression, propagating into an unchecked arithmetic result.
decimals is used as the exponent in the supply multiplication expression.
Result of the unchecked multiplication is written into totalSupply.
msg.sender indexes balanceOf for the creator allotment and for burn paths.
_from selects the balance decremented in _transfer without checked arithmetic.
_to selects the balance incremented in _transfer without checked arithmetic.
_value is the amount subtracted and added in the balance update.
Unsafe arithmetic operation mutates the balanceOf mapping entries.
_value is the amount subtracted from totalSupply in burn and burnFrom.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the totalSupply state variable.
_spender determines the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
_extraData is forwarded verbatim into the external callback payload.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the external receiveApproval call.
transfer delegates state mutation to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer after allowance accounting.
approveAndCall invokes approve and requires its boolean success.
Constructor execution performs the unchecked supply multiplication.
_transfer execution performs the unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
burn execution performs the unchecked totalSupply subtraction.
burnFrom execution performs the unchecked totalSupply subtraction.
msg.sender selects the allowance owner/spender pair that authorizes the delegated transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner set by approve, granting spending rights.
msg.sender balance is the target of the burn operation.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is verified and decremented in burnFrom.
External receiveApproval call to an attacker-controlled spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall before it returns.
Re-entrant callback can invoke transferFrom while approveAndCall has not completed its external call.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter initialSupply exists solely to feed the unchecked supply multiplication.
tokenName is only assigned to the name state variable inside the constructor.
tokenSymbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable inside the constructor.
_from is the address key for the unchecked balance decrement in _transfer.
_to is the address key for the unchecked balance increment in _transfer.
_value is the amount applied in the unsafe balance and allowance arithmetic.
_spender becomes the target contract of the receiveApproval external call.
_extraData is forwarded unchanged into the external callback invocation.
previousBalances is derived from and asserted against the balances mutated by the unsafe update.
The local spender tokenRecipient handle is the receiver of the external call.
